allowlist.note: Customer-side configuration only; shared edge IPs out-of-scope

denylist: AWS CloudFront shared edge IP ranges

allowed: web vulnerability testing (SQLi, XSS, SSRF, IDOR, auth flaws, file upload, path traversal, etc.)
non-brute-force authn/authz probing with provided test accounts
banner grabbing / version detection on confirmed services
verification of hard-coded credentials ONLY against the apparent owner's resources after read-only sts:GetCallerIdentity
forbidden: credential stuffing / password spraying / brute force
data exfiltration / leaking of sensitive data
